profile.org_note: Small, centrally run private builder: a CEO (Joe Harris) and a short corporate team in Joplin over four market areas (Joplin metro, Springfield, Northwest Arkansas, Northeast Oklahoma); no published leadership page. Land appears to sit with co-founder Dan Mitchell and an affiliated Joplin developer, Land Development Group (unconfirmed title), and finance with the CFO; the company has been 100% owned by an employee stock ownership plan since 2020.
profile.summary: Faith-based, 100% employee-owned (ESOP, public benefit corporation since 2020) entry-level and move-up builder founded in Joplin after the 2011 tornado; it passed 5,000 homes sold in mid-2026, has about 230 employees and builds in southwest Missouri, Springfield MO, Northwest Arkansas and the Tulsa area. It already uses TPG Angelo Gordon's Essential Housing for finished-lot land banking in Northwest Arkansas (three recorded option deals, Dec 2025 to Oct 2026) and buys finished lots from third-party developers such as Calara, so it is a live land-banking customer with a competitor already in the account.

people.name: Dan Mitchell
people.title: Co-Founder; Chief Land Officer and CEO of Land Development Group
people.prior_role: Founder of Bridge Ministries, Joplin; co-founded the builder in 2011
people.source_title: Atlantic Management Company advises on ESOP transaction for Schuber Mitchell Homes (press release)
people.note: Co-founder status is stated in the opened 2020 ESOP release (it mentions three selling shareholders but does not name them; checker 2026-11-19 corrected an earlier claim that he was named as one). The Whitebridge directory lists him as Owner. The land title 'Chief Land Officer & CEO of Land Development Group' was seen only in a search-result summary of a company blog post ('Our Story: How Schuber Mitchell Homes Got Started') that now redirects to the blog index, so it is not confirmed. A Homes for HOPE partner page (undated profile) still lists him as 'Owner & CEO', which conflicts with Joe Harris as CEO and looks stale. Confirm his current role before calling. Title note: Land title unconfirmed.

people.name: Joe Harris
people.title: CEO
people.prior_role: Owner of Harris Homes, merged into Schuber Mitchell Homes in 2016
people.source_title: Architect Magazine firm listing: Schuber Mitchell Homes (Builder 100 data)
people.note: Listed as CEO on the firm listing (carries 2025 Builder 100 data); search snippets of Builder's 2026 profile and a 2025 Builder article also call him CEO. Talk Business (Aug 2024) names a 'Joseph Harris' as manager of Peacock Galactic LLC of Joplin, an entity that bought completed homes from the builder; probably the same person, not confirmed.

people.name: Daman Schuber
people.title: Co-Founder
people.note: Full name John Daman Schuber. Talk Business (Feb and May 2025) reports that his Shared Services LLC shares an address with Joplin residential developer Land Development Group and took a 10.25% interest in 61 acres of Mills Farm in Rogers, AR. Day-to-day role at the builder since the 2020 ESOP sale is not public.

people.name: Oscar Antillon
people.title: Vice President of New Business and Development
people.source_title: Homes for HOPE: Schuber Mitchell Homes Discovering HOPE Experience (Tulsa)
people.note: Named with this title in two Homes for HOPE posts (2025-01-30 in Bentonville and 2025-09-25 in Tulsa) and quoted on entering new markets, so he appears to lead new-market entry (Tulsa opened 2025-2026). Whether land acquisition sits under him is not stated; a likely contact for expansion-market lot needs.

people.name: Aaron Eidson

people.note: Company spokesman on the Cronkhite Homes acquisition. The company release is from August 2024 (over two years old); a 2025 Builder article seen only as a search snippet repeats the title. Current title not confirmed for 2026.

people.name: Andy Lett
